== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Leia Seeker (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (PC Gallery Text)|Leia Seeker (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 18 December 2007 at 11:40:31 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
